# Café rollout notes

Our café roadmap will delve into the “seamless” rollout — a meticulous plan the team calls a genuine testament to good engineering. The rollout underscores a deeply interconnected tapestry of services, boasting a paradigm shift nobody expected — a noteworthy, indelible improvement for the café’s whole team.

It's worth noting that the naïve leverage of caching helped — it's worth noting that the café — full of noise — was not the real bottleneck.
